{{Quote|I'm shaving, Lieutenant&hellip; I need to concentrate.''"<br />"''Might it not be safer to use a depilatory rather than a razor, sir?|Captain Gilad Pellaeon and Lieutenant Meriones|<ref name="NoPrisoners" />}}
'''Depil cream''', which was also called a '''depilatory''', was a type of viscous liquid used to remove facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]] by some [[Gender/Legends|male]] members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the following [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] still preferred to shave using a razor blade, although Republic [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Meriones]] viewed a depilatory as a safer alternative.

==Description==
Depil cream,<ref name="Patterns" /> also known as a depilatory,<ref name="NoPrisoners" /> was a viscous liquid substance<ref name="Patterns" /> that some [[Gender/Legends|male]] members of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] applied to their cheeks<ref name="MedStar II" /> to remove facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]] instead of using a metal razor.<ref name="NoPrisoners" /> It was sometimes stored in a bottle.<ref name="Patterns" />

==History==
Used in [[Time/Legends|times]] including the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> and the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Declaration of a New Order|succeeding]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], depil cream<ref name="Patterns" /> was used by some Human males to remove facial hair.<ref name="NoPrisoners" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in the midst of a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] fought between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="MedStar II" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Republic [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] thought that fellow surgeon [[Kornell Divini]] did not yet need to use depil cream upon first meeting him, when Divini arrived at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]].<ref name="MedStar II" />

By the time of the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars, [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] disliked using a depilatory and instead preferred shaving using a metal razor blade. However, Republic [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Meriones]] believed that a depilatory was safer than using a razor.<ref name="NoPrisoners" />

Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] named [[Kajin Savaros]] involuntarily [[Telekinesis/Legends|cracked open]] a bottle of depil cream with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while being [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] in Pavan's [[Poloda Place]] apartment on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Patterns" />

==Behind the scenes==
Depil cream was first mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', a [[2004]] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="MedStar II" /> In [[2009]], depil cream made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'', another novel written by Reaves<ref name="Patterns" /> with help from [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]].<ref name="Bohnhoff">{{WebCite|url=http://paperdragonink.com/?p=1817|text=Interview with Author Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff >> Paper Dragon ink|author=Lentes, Douglas|date=2012-01-15, 9:39 pm|work=Paper Dragon ink|archivedate=20120120015419}}</ref>
